mentions.name: Ground-up CRM with AI workflows
mentions.description: This CRM is being built from the ground up to make common day-to-day customer relationship tasks as easy as possible. It integrates AI thoughtfully across customer workflows rather than bolting on a chatbot, including letting customers build custom AI workflows for higher-level tasks like building dashboards, connecting data sources, and invoicing customers. It is being built by a three-person, unfunded team focused first on nailing the basics.
mentions.problem: Existing CRMs are bad at supporting the common day-to-day tasks customers need, and many take on too much VC funding, which pushes them to prioritize ROI over continually improving the product.
mentions.audience: Businesses, especially smaller businesses, that need CRM workflows made easy rather than working at a low technical level.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're building a new CRM from the ground up. We've helped a handful of companies and non-profits set up CRMs and it's amazing how bad existing CRMs are. It's like they don't understand what common day to day tasks need to be made as easy as possible.
